method.error: Absolute RGB channel differences multiplied by 255 in both spaces; not a perceptual metric.
method.reference: Tagged camera stages at exact CC0, channel order and RGB primaries, without serialized matrix rounding or LUT.
method.exposure: Positive gain and negative SDK tone applied in CC0 coordinates before camera gamma; a structure model, not camera exposure gain.
method.original: Original 33^3 grid, seeded random and shadow RGB, known test points and CC0 planes (check_gold_lut_fidelity.py).
method.held_out: Shifted 17^3 grid, 8192 uniform and 2048 log-dark RGB, CC0 clipping probes, and bracketed 0/1 crossings along new seeded sensor RGB lines. Final sRGB transitions to clipped plateaus are reported separately. Sensor neutrals and eight structural corners are fixed anchors, which can also occur in the original data.
method.lut_codes: 16-bit table entries at corners (each index 0 or 31), the internal neutral diagonal (all three indices equal) and the wireframe (at least two indices 0 or 31). The grid and sensor cube are distinct domains. Raw code comparison assumes both LUT domains match.
method.gamut: Adobe RGB recipes only. An ideal pixel qualifies if at least one linear sRGB channel lies outside [0,1] by over 1/255. The wide-gamut output is tested on the same channel and side, before sRGB clipping.
method.summary: Each largest-per-case metric is the maximum of individual-case statistics, not a percentile computed across rows.
method.validation: Both previous release tags replay all published v3 original and held-out results in both spaces; staged v2 encoded sRGB also replayed. DCP equality, LUT shape/quantization, anchors and offline sRGB renderer checked.
method.fresh_global: 8192 uniform and 2048 log-dark inputs (PCG64), unused for candidate design; same points across cases
method.local_neighborhood: HARUBENI worst witnesses, center omitted, Cartesian offsets of 0, ±1/8, ±1/4 encoded LUT cell widths along free axes. Clipped coordinates fixed. Reported separately from whole-domain samples.
method.matched_witnesses: Every renderer and the direct reference are evaluated at the same sensor coordinates for each distinct original-sample worst point of each version. Published v2/v3 coordinates are kept verbatim. Signed error is (output − reference) × 255.
method.stage_commutation_residuals: Diagnostic signed jumps when moving interpolation through consecutive nonlinear stages. The decomposition depends on the operation order and does not by itself prove the mechanism for other points.
